lead.headline: Golden is questionable; Pickens is ready
lead.deck: 1-6. The lineup is the projection lineup. One check left: Thursday 16:45.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Matthew Golden is questionable for Thursday night with a shoulder and a foot; Green Bay only held walkthroughs, and he was listed limited on the final report. Check inactives at 16:45 Thursday; if he is out, George Pickens takes his slot. Rashee Rice practised for the first time since Week 4 today, but he stays on the bench. This afternoon Xavier Worthy was dropped for Kyle Pitts, a third tight end; Atlanta list Michael Penix Jr. as the starter. Everything else is set: the lineup as set is the projection lineup, 126.6 to Metcalf Gala's 121.2, 53%.
